author: vhegde91
body:
- This PR fixes the issues reported here: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51665#issuecomment-5424772514
- runTheMatrix tests for workflows 2500.0302 and 4.45 were successful.
- It handles era based `metFilterPaths` and runs `hcalBadDigiFilter` for Run 3 only.
- HCAL channel status using DB is updated.
- Almost no change to physics apart from what is done in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51665
title: Improved Run 3 HBHE bad digi event filter
